Figure uses representative profile/extrusion parameters; actual G1 tessellates IfcColumn.Representation and writes PLY vertices (x,y,z) and triangle vertex_indices.
Same illustrative IFC attributes; actual G2 uses the IfcOpenShell geometry engine and exports the element's transformed mesh.
Dimensions illustrate rectangular extrusions, not guaranteed properties of every wall. Actual output is wall_*.ply.
The figure's dimensional boxes are representative only. The current G4 does not directly read XDim/YDim/Depth, but tessellates the IFC geometric representation.
Figure combines these with Other elements. G5 tessellates window geometry and emits a PLY mesh.
G6 tessellates the slab's IFC geometry and emits a PLY mesh.
G7 maps roofs; IfcMember, IfcPlate, IfcRailing, IfcStairFlight, IfcBuildingElementProxy and similar elements use mesh_from_product, without adding G8+ functions.
P1 is called for material identity and provenance; the current model.xml records the IFC material name in a comment, not a <Name> element.
W6 calls P2 to convert/sum IFC layer thickness. If missing, thickness-only CSV baseline overrides are used, then explicit CLI --default-thickness-m.
When available, an associated RGB surface style becomes the optional <rgb name="color" .../> child of a radio-material BSDF.
The conversion setting is 3.5 GHz by default. Frequency and wavelength are XML comments, not a numeric radio-material field; downstream Sionna must separately set scene.frequency.
Pset_MaterialWirelessPropagation → baseline-only override CSV → ITU class ε′r = a fGHz^b, written as <float name="relative_permittivity">.
μr=1 is assumed/validated; it is written only to provenance, not as a BSDF numeric field.
Pset_MaterialWirelessPropagation → baseline-only override CSV → ITU class σ = c fGHz^d, written as <float name="conductivity">.
The figure's loss is a conceptual propagation quantity. W5 writes scattering_coefficient=0 and xpd_coefficient=0 defaults (unless overridden); no ReflectionLoss dB.
W6 prepares <float name="thickness">; it does not calculate transmission loss in dB. IFC LayerThickness takes precedence.
W7 checks shared-edge triangular mesh topology and sets face_normals. Actual diffraction/wedge-path loss is not computed by this converter.
